seo.description: The HeyAtom brand: mark, logo, colour, type, shapes, motion, voice and downloadable files.
seo.ogDescription: Mark, logo, colours and a kit to download.

brand.intro: A hand saying hi, one green, two typefaces. These are the rules this site is built with, plus the files to use the mark elsewhere.

mark.title: The mark.
mark.body: The Vulcan salute: a hello, nerd style. The hand lives alone or inside the bubble, a circle with one corner at 10%.
mark.small: The mark stands alone where the logo won't fit: favicons, avatars, the header below 480 px.

logo.title: The logo.
logo.body: Mark plus HeyAtom in Manrope ExtraBold, outlined. Horizontal is the default, stacked is for square formats.
logo.spaceBody: X is half the cap height. X between hand and name, at least 2X around the logo.
logo.minBody: Logo 96 px wide, mark 16 px. Below 480 px screens the header keeps only the hand.

icon.title: The icon.
icon.body: The hand alone, no frame and no bubble, on any ground. green by default; where it doesn't hold up, the light or dark step of the same green.

editions.title: Special editions.
editions.body: For a few days the hand dresses up for the occasion. Only the mark changes, in the favicon, the header and the home page; wordmark, green and copy stay the same. They switch on by themselves based on the date.

color.title: The colour.
color.body: One green on charcoal neutrals. Green behaves like light: it fills little and lights up the rest.
rules: Solid green only on the primary button and small marks. Elsewhere it's text, hairline or glow. Never a section background.
Every divider is a 1 px line in green at 16%. No grey borders.
Ground and text are untinted greys: green stays the only colour.
Follows the system, dark by default. On light, text green drops to #007A4D for contrast.

type.title: The type.
type.body: Manrope for everything you read, JetBrains Mono for data only.
rules: Headings from 700 to 800 with negative tracking, tighter as they grow. Never light.
Years, stacks, counts. Never headings, kickers or sentences, never spaced caps.

shape.title: Shapes and depth.
shape.body: Tight corners, soft black shadows, green only as emitted light.
shape.circle: Circles · dots and icon buttons only
shape.shadowBody: Negative spread, only on what actually lifts.
shape.glowBody: Primary CTA and glowing dots only.
shape.glassBody: Blur exists only on the header.

motion.title: The motion.
motion.body: Rich but never above the content. With reduced motion on, the site is static.
items: One curve for almost everything, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1).
Every animation goes through gsap.matchMedia and is reverted on unmount.
Hero and page heads animate only position and blur, never opacity.

voice.title: The voice.
voice.body: A person, not a company. First person, “you” to the reader, warm and direct.
pairs: I build custom websites and web apps.
Years of experience serving our clients.

dont.title: Don't.
list: 999 px pills or radii other than 10/14 px
Card grids for uniform lists: they're rows
